Apply when progress reception serves distinct visits and physical attempts, startup can emit synchronously, decoding may finish later, and audit and presentation have different lifetimes. README.md: "Selecting a file creates a visit. Retry replaces the physical attempt without
opening another visit. Selecting the same file object again opens a new visit." README.md: "The source is shared by attempts and visits for that file. start may emit cached
packets synchronously; decoding yields a full frame, immediately or later.
Decode completion order can differ from packet arrival order." Confirm these premises before transferring this guidance.

Install panel reception before starting the source, while preserving subsequent streaming and source reuse. Original src/workflow.rb: "env.call('start',file['token']);subscription=env.call('listen',file['token'],callback)". Guard admission using the originating subscription and visit, including during startup before the outer caller receives its handle. README.md: "One startup window is relevant to this maintenance request: start may emit
more than one packet synchronously. A showProgress callback may select or hide
another visit before start returns, while its caller has not yet received the
returned cleanup handle." Retirement must prevent subsequent admission without relying solely on eventual physical cleanup.

Where the task explicitly requires protection against out-of-order full frames, capture reception order before decoding and retain a publication watermark for the visit, spanning its retries. Publish an eligible completion only if it cannot replace a newer frame already displayed. Commit the watermark before invoking callback-capable presentation so reentrant publication cannot restore older authority. TASK: "Full
progress frames may decode out of order; do not allow an older frame to roll the
current display backward." Compare reception order rather than numeric progress: README.md states, "A full frame replaces displayed state; loaded values can decrease or reset." Continue auditing suppressed older completions.

Bind accepted decoding to its originating file, attempt and visit. README.md: "recordProgress appends transfer history; showProgress paints the open panel." Because audit callbacks may navigate synchronously, an admission-time validity check cannot replace the publication-time check. Already accepted decoding is not automatically ineligible for display solely because retry canceled its attempt while the visit remains current.

Repeated removal is\ninert. Host callbacks execute synchronously unless explicitly deferred." Keep cancellation and disposal independent for each workspace.

No separate authorization is supplied.
